== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Aetheric sigils are magical symbols derived from the natural patterns found within the [[Aether]]. They serve as a fundamental component of spellcasting, functioning similarly to verbal incantations but through physical or mental tracing. These symbols can be manifested in various colors—such as silver-gray, turquoise, pink-and-orange, honey, or white—and can be drawn in the air with hands or wands, engraved on [[stone]], or integrated into complex magic circle{{!}}magic circles and seals. Sigils are used for a wide range of purposes, including creating protective forcefields, [[binding]] individuals, summoning spirits, and facilitating rebirth. They can be used to manipulate elements like [[water]] or [[wind]], enchant objects such as crystals, or power advanced [[Aethertech]] devices and ship mechanisms. Because they resonate with the [[Aether]], sigils can carry immense information regarding intentions and magical connections, and their presence can indicate the use of specific rituals or even the influence of powerful entities like [[World Spirits]].}}

== The Captain ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|Aetheric sigils manifest as swirling white discs during the casting of the [[Absolute Burial]] spell. These markings can be identified by their patterns, such as those appearing on a mud bubble, and they may be traced using one's hands. The sigils serve as functional indicators that can glow to signal alerts or flicker white when set against the darkness.}}
